## ResolvableObjectReferenceData type

Data of a single-object reference to `Resources` that a client can resolve: the resource has `get`<!-- -->, and so does that of every container, at every level, and a resource whose `get` records a parent carries that parent's identity container.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ResolvableObjectReferenceData<Resources extends ResourceTable> = {
  [Key in ResolvableResourceKey<Resources, 'one'>]:
    | (IdentityReferenceData<ResourceIdOf<Resources, Key>, Key> &
        ResolvableContainmentOf<Resources, Key, 'get'>)
    | (SelectorReferenceData<Key> & ResolvableContainmentOf<Resources, Key, 'get'>)
}[ResolvableResourceKey<Resources, 'one'>]
```
